what: A thick ribbon line (SVG path) winding broadly around the screen is drawn to the end in 2s sine.in, and from the moment it is fully drawn it is erased from the tail in 2s sine.out and exits — meanwhile its thickness swells and thins like breathing, .7 → 1 → .7x (each 2s sine.inOut). Rest 1s and draw again. It starts looping when the section reaches 85% of the screen, and if scrolling stops for 4s it finishes the current lap and stops (restarts on touch)

options.dur: Draw and erase durations each (seconds), default 2 — company about, gallery and history 1.5, sounds of the temple 1
options.dir: With reverse, the line is drawn forward from its end
options.idle: Time until settling after scrolling stops (ms), default 4000
options.host: Fixed panel css (e.g. ”.am-kv”) — when given, it turns that panel on and off with its fx:enter and fx:leave (pin-layer-pan)

from.where: shared.js .js-bgline (seven hero panels, About, Gallery, Employee Voices, Future, History, and the red ribbon in the Footer — original bglineAnim: DrawSVG 0%→100% 2s sine.in, tail erased after 2s sine.out, thickness .7↔1, 1s rest, resumes after 4s of scroll stillness)
